name: Yanahara Rie
source:
She is the wife of a surgeon Yanahara who is in a factional war with Sakaguchi. Apparently, Yanahara is so busy with work that they don't have much time to spend together.

She has both the sex appeal of a married woman and the ladylike charm of a young lady.

[From [url=https://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=1134]Getchu[/url]]
